name: cross_iteration_candidates
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file
method: join Iteration 2 shortlist/ladder, Iteration 4 generators/safety, and Iteration 5 R1-R4 under uncalibrated and hierarchy-calibrated route weights

sources.clinical: ressources/hackathon-rules/Challenge_Clinical_Phenotype_1.md (8 HPO terms enter through Iteration 2's rhabdomyosarcoma direction D4, Iteration 4's MGI phenotype twin and OnSIDES/FAERS safety table, and Iteration 5's nephrocalcinosis/chemotherapy avoid rules)
sources.genomic: BUB1B compound-heterozygous consequence classes (stop_gained exon 17 + missense exon 23), Fact F8 mosaic aneuploidy bound (<= 1.6-3%), and PharmCAT PGx summary; no genomic position is read or written

assumptions: route ceiling calibration maps R2 (single-line HCT116 proteomics residual without mechanism, raw max 0.700) to weight 0.25 (effective max 0.175 < 0.192), below R3's approved in-vivo Bub1b^{H/H} mouse rescue (niacin/nicotinamide, 0.192) and R1/R3's in-vivo NMN benchmark (0.480)
limitations: heuristic decision utilities are for transparent triage and experiment pricing, not calibrated clinical probabilities; SLCO1B1 is uncalled in the 1.6%-covered VCF and requires a targeted PGx panel before statin dosing
validation: reproduces Iteration 5 R4 uncalibrated numbers byte-for-byte at w=(1,1,1) and verifies EVPI=0.1800 and EVSI(chx_chase_blot)/EVPI = 59.1-69.1% across all 20 grid points of w_R2 in [0.05, 1.00]
